snippet.title: Cook with Card | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Cook with Card is a cozy restaurant management game where every meal is created using cards.

Process ingredients, prepare recipes, serve customers and build your own restaurant in a relaxing cooking simulation.

The Demo is available now on Steam.

Wishlist Cook with Card on Steam and play the demo today.

Features:

*Cozy restaurant management
* Unique card-based cooking mechanics
* Satisfying food preparation
* Relaxing gameplay
* Pizza restaurant simulation
* Serve customers and expand your kitchen
